characters.description: a sleepless young observatory astronomer with short dark hair, navy jacket, silver star pin, standing on the LEFT inside a glass-dome control room
characters.name: Tess

characters.description: a pragmatic bearded station caretaker with red knit cap and olive work jacket, standing on the RIGHT inside the same glass-dome observatory control room
characters.name: Rho

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's sunrise is only a projection.

dialogue.speaker: Rho
dialogue.text: Then give me a real horizon.

dialogue.speaker: Rho
dialogue.text: Then we will watch the stars.

premise: At a night-shift observatory, Tess's projected dawn fails and Rho insists on the real sky above them.
title: LF004 Operator Dogfood: Borrowed Sunrise
